title: Crown of Cinders: Hidden Law
description: Crown of Cinders unfolds across cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame, pushing a 5-Titan Infernal Dominion Titan to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Crown of Cinders: Hidden Law advances Cinders of Dominion: The Black Iron Court turns Gate wounds into bargains, proving ambition can defend a Realm only when power accepts consequence. It directly tests the faction tension: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
terrain: cinder crown gate under obsidian arches and royal flame

objectives.primary: Cleanse the Gate wound without breaking Infernal Dominion realm law.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Infernal Dominion faction mechanics

reinforcement from the Gate wound flank

specialRules: Bargain Mark: accepting risk creates stronger rewards but harsher enemy turns.
Dominion Flame: decisive aggression turns enemy weakness into momentum.
